name: Vyomi Sandbox — AWS (full)
//: S3 · DynamoDB · SQS · SNS · IAM · KMS · Secrets Manager · RDS · EC2. Shares ../boot.sh + ../docker-compose.sandbox.yml.
//postCreate: Pre-install boto3 so developers use native AWS SDK/CLI immediately (no 'aws: command not found'), then boot the stack.
postCreateCommand: pip install --quiet boto3 botocore 2>/dev/null || true; bash .devcontainer/boot.sh up
